det.korean: 조동사 may 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로, 명사 facilitation → 동사 facilitate.
det.analysis:

may는 조동사로 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 함. 주어진 단어 facilitation은 명사이므로, 동사원형 facilitate로 변환.

det.tip: 명사 promotion → 동사 promote → 3인칭 단수 promotes. 병렬 구조(creates and promotes)에서 수일치 주의

questions.passage: The ability to understand emotions — to have a diverse emotion vocabulary and to understand the causes and consequences of emotion — is particularly relevant in group settings. Individuals who ____ are able to express emotions, feelings and moods accurately and thus, may facilitate clear communication between co-workers. Furthermore, they may be more likely to act in ways that accommodate their own needs as well as the needs of others (i.e. cooperate). In a group conflict situation, for example, a member with a strong ability to understand emotion will be able to express how he feels about the problem and why he feels this way. He also should be able to take the perspective of the other group members and understand why they are reacting in a certain manner. Appreciation of differences creates an arena for open communication and promotes constructive conflict resolution and improved group functioning.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 감정을 정확히 표현하고 소통을 촉진하는 사람 = '이 영역에 능숙한 사람'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① are skilled in this domain — '이 영역(감정 이해)에 능숙한'이 문맥에 정확히 맞음.
❌ ② fear emotional conflicts — '감정 갈등을 두려워하는'은 반대 의미.
❌ ③ ignore others' needs — '타인의 요구를 무시하는'은 뒤 문장(accommodate)과 모순.
❌ ④ avoid group settings — '집단 환경을 피하는'은 전체 글 주제와 반대.
det.tip: 이 문제의 빈칸 자리는 원문에서 are skilled in this domain — 앞뒤 문맥(감정 이해·표현·협력)이 모두 긍정적 주체를 가리킴
